Start Here

Provide the onboarding flow for an operator's first session.

1. Prepare your environment

You need three things to run the Autonomous Duck Deployment Framework:

  • A capable LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
  • A terminal
  • A markdown editor

2. Download the Starter Kit

Download the blank starter kit from the Downloads page. Extract it into your project directory. This provides the canonical file structure.

3. Initialize the Project Brain

Open STATE.md, DOMAIN.md, and DECISIONS.md. Fill in the placeholder details for your project. The files are the project — these definitions will guide every AI session moving forward.

4. Run your first session

Copy the first-session prompt from the prompt catalog, load the required files, and declare the mode. You are now operating within ADDF.
